snippet.title: The Legacy - A New Cooperative Survival Horror Game!
snippet.description:
Add to your wishlist now - https://cutt.ly/9elDzaPb



Dive into a cooperative survival horror experience! Return to your cursed, dark homeland. Can you survive the harsh environment and stop the evil? Your skills and teamwork will be the key. Are you ready for the challenge?
